title: Component library catalogue
description: contracts/component-library.json: the app's shared UI components and the facts the ui-component-library checkers read. The checkers stay strict; the facts belong to the app.

uiDir.description: The shared components folder, repo-relative. Default: the layout's uiDir (src/ui), or rn-skills.config.json.

exclude.description: Globs (relative to uiDir) of folders other skills own: the accessibility hooks, the icon set, the motion moments, the list-detail layout, the feedback ladder. Default ["a11y/**", "icons/**", "motion/**", "adaptive/**", "feedback/**"].

specs.description: Generated component measurements, or false when components take every size from the theme tokens and named constants.

block.description: The token file's key that holds the component groups. Default components.

module.description: The typed import of it. Default <uiDir>/component-specs.ts.

asRenderedBorders.description: Floor CSS borders as a browser draws them (2.5 -> 2), only when the approved design references are browser renders. Default false.

overrides.description: Values that differ from the token file, each with the reason (the design rule or decision).

path.description: Dotted path in the components block (chip.radius).

prerequisites.description: Files of other skills the components import; a missing one is a problem. Default: the theme modules, AppText, PressableSurface, the press feedback context, the render helper and the pressable audit. {themeDir}, {uiDir} and {testDir} are filled from the layout.

mustContain.description: A marker an up-to-date copy holds.

ownedElsewhere.description: Single files in the ui folder that other skills create and keep, added to the defaults ({uiDir}/screen-frame.tsx and {uiDir}/subtree-error-boundary.tsx: react-components-and-hooks; {uiDir}/physical-direction-view.tsx: rtl-and-direction; {uiDir}/screen-body.tsx: screen-contracts; {uiDir}/ad-banner-slot.tsx: admob-ads-and-consent). Never discovered, never unlisted; listing one under components checks it after all.

file.description: Repo-relative; {uiDir} is filled from the layout.

owner.description: The skill that creates and keeps it.

pressHosts.description: The only ui files that may import Pressable, a Touchable or a gesture-handler button, each running the press feedback. Default ["pressable-surface.tsx"].

testID.description: required (default): a required testID prop; optional: decorative parts whose owner passes <owner>.<part>; none.

parts.description: Part ids the component derives from its testID (`${testID}.label`).

hidesItself.description: A decorative part that hides itself from VoiceOver and TalkBack.

mayRotate.description: May use a rotate transform (a drawn glyph, a decorative tilt).

mayShadow.description: May cast a static shadow (it floats: a dialog, a toast, a thumb).

inPairCell.description: Sits in a cell of a row or grid: grows with flexGrow, never flex: 1.

modalRoot.description: The overlay root: the only place for accessibilityViewIsModal; closes on Android back.

drawnUnderline.description: Draws its underline as a bar (no textDecorationLine).

holdFill.description: A hold-to-confirm fill that must sit in a track pinned to the face edges.

scatter.description: A decorative scatter placed by start offsets: lays out left to right.

mockOnly.description: Design stand-ins the app never builds (an ad box, an OS sheet).
